results.title: Donald Trump Takes Credit for Netanyahu's Performance in Israeli Elections
results.description: US President Donald Trump has taken credit for the performance of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Tuesday's elections, citing his earlier endorsement. The Likud party had fared better than expected, but Netanyahu's future remains uncertain.

results.title: Investing in conventional weapons better than developing nuclear program of one's own – expert
results.description: The best security guarantees are membership in the North Atlantic Alliance or, at the very least, protection under a "nuclear umbrella," while possessing nuclear weapons of one's own is too expensive and dangerous.
